protocol.cache_policy: Separate priming run; no cache clearing or reboot; load measured after imports
protocol.sequence: 4 rounds of 5 fresh workers per configuration; rotated/reversed configuration order

dataset.name: COCO val2017
dataset.selection: First 200 image filenames in lexicographic order from all 5000 images; repeated identically across configurations

limitations: Load percentiles use only 20 fresh-process samples per configuration.
Loads use preprimed package/OS caches and exclude interpreter/library imports; these are not cold-start measurements.
Inference includes model preprocessing and postprocessing, but excludes image reading, decoding and scenario resizing.
RSS includes the worker and 200 predecoded images; excludes CoreML service processes and is not accelerator allocator memory.
Compute-unit configuration does not establish actual graph execution placement.

executed_allocation.method: Actual Instruments Core AI + Core ML recording; hardware events and sampled runtime stacks during 100 predictions after 30 warmups. Five COCO images; batch one; same exact PR source and packages as latency measurements. CPU and GPU filtered by launched PID. ANE table has no PID: attribution uses weights_<UUID> prediction labels and isolated model run. Edges trimmed 2 ms due to TOC wall clock precision.
limitations: CPU samples are statistical observations, not operator counts or percentages.
ANE/GPU interval counts are instrumentation events, not numbers of graph nodes.
Legacy Core ML per-operation signpost table is empty; this does not recover a full per-node executed allocation map.
Absence of a sampled CPU symbol does not prove absence of CPU execution.
Instrumented timing must not be compared to uninstrumented latency.
